critical_validations.all_statements_processed_through_dms_not: All 7 statements were attempted through DMS tool. DMS tool failed for all statements due to metadata model creation/conversion timeouts. Per transformation definition, manual conversions were applied with full documentation.
critical_validations.all_statements_validated_for_equivalency: All 7 statement pairs were validated through SQL Equivalency tool. Tool returned EQUIVALENT for 2 statements, ERROR/UNKNOWN for 5 statements. No agent judgment was used - all statuses are from tool output only.
critical_validations.no_agent_judgment_used_for_equivalency_n: Confirmed. All equivalency status determinations came solely from the SQL Equivalency tool. UNKNOWN results were marked as ERROR per transformation definition, not converted to EQUIVALENT based on agent judgment.
critical_validations.schema_transformations_respected_notes: No schema transformations were applied by DMS tool. All table names (Products, ProductHistory, ProductStats) remain unchanged. No column renames. All schema object references in code match the schema.
critical_validations.compilation_successful_notes: Application compiles successfully with 0 errors. Build completed in 4.48 seconds. 10 nullable reference type warnings present (pre-existing, unrelated to migration).

ado_net_conversion.api_notes: All ADO.NET APIs (ExecuteReaderAsync, ExecuteScalarAsync, ExecuteNonQueryAsync, Parameters.AddWithValue, BeginTransactionAsync, CommitAsync, RollbackAsync) work identically between SqlClient and Npgsql. Parameter prefix @ is supported by Npgsql.

schema_transformations.notes: No schema transformations applied. DMS tool did not modify any schema object names. All original table and column names preserved.
